description: Adds images to a product from public image URLs. By default they are downloaded and stored in the shop's own file storage (so the storefront does not depend on the source site). Optionally makes the first one the thumbnail.

set_thumbnail.description: Make the first new image the thumbnail

store_copy.description: Upload a copy to the shop's storage instead of linking the URL

name: add_product_images
title: Add product images
